title: Ngā Kairangahau e Moe Ana i te Pono
intro: Whakaarohia tētahi wā i whakahēngia ai te whakapono, ā, i whiriwhiria e tētahi rōpū wairua te whakapono pumau, kaua te whakamarie o te ao. I te aroaro o tētahi kōwhiringa whakamataku, ka rapu piringa rātou, ka tīmata i tētahi haerenga i arahi atu ai ki tētahi moe tino whakamīharo. Ko tā rātou kōrero he tohu mō te tiakitanga atua me te mana o te whakapono ki te tukino. Ka taea e koe te kite i te tuakiri o ēnei tāngata whakamiharo?
clues: He whakaminenga iti mātou, i honoa e te whakapono hohonu ki te Kaihanga Kotahi.
I ora tātou i te wā i tono ai tetahi rangatira kaha kia karakiahia tētahi atu mea i tua atu i a Allah.
Hei tiaki i tō mātou whakapono, i whakatau mātou ki te whakarērea ō mātou kāinga, ka rere atu i te tukino.
I haere tahi mātou i tā mātou haerenga me tētahi hoa pono, he mea hanga nō te whenua.
I kitea e mātou he piringa i tētahi wāhi mokemoke, ā, i reira ka meinga mātou e Atua kia moe roa, kia hohonu.
I tō mātou oho ake, i whakapono mātou he rā, he wāhanga rānei o te rā kua pahemo, engari kua tino pahemo ngā rautau.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: E whakamatautauria ana ki te whenua pakoko
Te tūtaki ki tētahi waipuke nui
Te rapu piringa mai i tētahi rangatira nanakia
Te maka ki roto i te ahi e mura ana
Te wero i te makutu a te tohunga makutu
trial.answer: Te rapu piringa mai i tētahi rangatira nanakia

outcome.label: Hua
options: He moe whakamiharo mō ngā rautau
Te whakaoranga mai i te tupuhi whakangaro
Te whakarato i tētahi tēpu rangi
outcome.answer: He moe whakamiharo mō ngā rautau

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
